purpose: Discover reproducible multi-domain state transitions and selectively validate mechanisms without promoting exploratory associations to causal or runtime evidence.
scope: CHAOS research-only; no modification of market-intelligence-engine, frozen baselines, raw data, or existing contracts.

status_model.rule: causal_validation_status is orthogonal to predictive_evidence_status; causal validation never bypasses the supervisor gate.

roles.supervisor: Validates schemas, provenance, frequency, leakage controls, null design, and admission status.
roles.domain_adapter: Maps one authorized source into source-native observations and DomainStates without changing raw values.
roles.discovery_evaluator: Runs pre-registered state-transition searches and null controls, recording all tested variants and failures.
roles.causal_validator: Runs only explicitly activated causal contracts with pre-specified estimand, treatment, controls, timing, and robustness tests.
roles.path_composer: Tests only qualified nodes/edges and applies path-level null controls; it cannot infer causality from composition.

discovery_track.name: ET
discovery_track.confidence_score: not permitted as an agent-assigned admission criterion; any ranking score must be deterministic and separately defined.

screening_policy.multiple_testing_correction: FDR or family-level correction for declared screening families; locked confirmation remains untouched and pre-registered.
screening_policy.nulls: Preserve the dependence structure relevant to the question: block/per-reporter permutation, identity-preserving permutation, restricted placebo timing, or clustered resampling as appropriate.
screening_policy.negative_controls: Must be selected and justified before results are viewed; a failed negative control is a diagnostic failure, not proof of causality.

causal_validation_queue.name: CVT_QUEUE
causal_validation_queue.activation: A candidate may enter the queue only after supervisor-approved discovery evidence and a new frozen causal contract.
causal_validation_queue.shock_rule: Historical shocks are candidate quasi-experimental variation, not assumed random assignment.
minimum_diagnostics: independent source or historical replication when feasible
causal_validation_queue.classification: Record causal validation separately; never overwrite the discovery status.

requirements: cross-entity or time holdout where applicable
forbidden: composing rejected/unresolved/not_testable nodes with positive weight
claiming causal path because individual edges are associated
searching arbitrary paths and reporting only the best p-value

stop_rules: Do not rerun a closed question by tuning thresholds after observing results.
Stop a family when its pre-registered search space is exhausted or when no new testable structure is opened.
Open a new contract/version when the source, outcome family, unit, frequency, or mechanism changes materially.
Do not start CVT when discovery evidence fails coverage, null validity, leakage, or stability gates.

priority_questions.question: Partner substitution or persistence after a major partner-share disruption; not contraction-to-GDP.
Differential response to an energy shock by pre-shock exposure, with predictive discovery before causal validation.
Event -> production shock -> recovery, keeping event and country-year representations distinct.

first_application_policy.initial_scope: One new question per contract; no five-agent p-value competition.

decision: Approved as the governing protocol for a new research campaign; this approval does not assert that any candidate edge exists or is causal.
